Code review of EquipamentoModal.jsx and intervention selects confirms <optgroup> by marca is implemented correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (visual verification of marca grouping in client equipment modal; code review confirmed optgroup in EquipamentoModal and intervention selects)

seed_data_creation: Created ~15 test equipments with prefix TEST_MARCA_<hex> on clients 560Lab and Albano R.N.Alves (client_ids[0] and [1]). All created equipments are cleaned up via DELETE in the session-scoped teardown fixture (soft-delete sets ativo=false). One leftover 'TEST_DuplicateBrand' equipment predates this iteration and remains on 560Lab.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Equipment endpoints verified: (1) GET /api/equipamentos?cliente_id=X returns list sorted by (marca asc, modelo asc). (2) POST /api/equipamentos with duplicate numero_serie returns 409 — uniqueness is GLOBAL across clients, whitespace-trimmed; error detail string includes serial, marca, modelo, and owner client name ('Cliente: <nome>'). (3) PUT /api/equipamentos/{id} with duplicate numero_serie returns 409 (current id excluded). (4) Empty or omitted numero_serie is allowed (multiple equipments can coexist without serial). (5) Frontend Equipamentos do Cliente modal groups by marca with amber h3 headers + Package icon + count; sort is alphabetical. (6) EquipamentoModal dropdown and intervention selects use <optgroup label="--- ${marca} ---">. No regressions found.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — feature addition verified end-to-end. Backend implementation in /app/backend/routes/equipamentos.py is idiomatic (async motor, soft-delete, strip normalization, $ne for self-exclusion on PUT). Frontend implementation uses Object.entries/reduce + sort by localeCompare which guarantees stable grouping + alphabetical display.
